title: Account Executive- SpringVerify
jobDescription:
Responsibilities Product Mastery: Acquire and maintain in-depth knowledge of Springworks’ offerings, ensuring you can discuss product features, advantages, and competitive differentiators. Collaborate with product teams based on client feedback to improve and customize solutions. Relationship Building: Establish and maintain robust relationships with key clients, understanding their business needs and challenges to provide tailored solutions. Ensure high-quality ongoing support and strategic insights to enhance client retention. Strategic Presentations: Design and deliver targeted presentations and proposals that effectively communicate the value of Springworks solutions to diverse stakeholders, ensuring alignment with their specific business requirements. Expert Negotiation: Direct negotiations, addressing client concerns and achieving consensus on pricing and terms that foster long-term partnerships. Sales Strategy Implementation: Implement and refine dynamic sales strategies like MEDDPIC, SANDLER, etc. to meet revenue goals, incorporating industry trends and best practices for continuous improvement. 1st Month
- Foundation Product Knowledge: Gain a deep understanding of Spring Verify products and services. Market Research: Research HR tech landscape, competitors, and target industries. Prospecting: Build a list of potential leads. Training: Attend product sessions and shadow AEs. Tools Familiarization: CRM, Prospecting, Deal Flow, Forecasting, Pipeline Management, etc. Sales Collateral: Develop pitch decks and email templates. Networking: Connect with HR professionals. Outreach: Start contacting leads. 2nd Month
- Relationship Building Relationship Building: Initiate client contact and build rapport. Sales Training: Participate in advanced sales training sessions for objection handling and negotiation. Lead Nurturing: Share relevant content with leads. KPI Setting: Collaborate with the sales manager to define key performance indicators (KPIs) for tracking progress. Feedback Loop: Align messaging with the team. Goal Setting: Set clear sales targets. Presentations: Deliver product demos. 3rd Month
- Sales Growth Collaboration: Work closely with the sales and marketing teams for lead generation and nurturing. Onboarding: If applicable, assist in the onboarding process for new clients. Forecasting: Predict deal outcomes. Reporting: Maintain accurate records using CRM software and generate initial sales reports. Learning: Continue to stay updated on industry trends, sales techniques, and product knowledge. Requirements 2-3 years of experience as an account executive, or in a similar role. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to build rapport and influence stakeholders. Strong sales and negotiation skills with a customer-focused approach. Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment. Proficiency in using CRM systems and sales tools. Benefits Our health scheme covers your physical, mental, and social well-being. Reimbursement of up to $30 per month for AI tool subscriptions to enhance learning and everyday productivity. 30 annual paid leave days to relax and recharge. Company outings and celebrations that bring the team together. Freedom and flexibility of asynchronous communication in a remote team environment. Learn More About Springworks Life at Springworks Glassdoor Reviews More about Asynchronous Communication Role details Location Remote Reposted Jul 19, 2026 Seniority Mid-level Hiring process 1 AI Voice Interview More from Springworks Software Development Engineer in Test Intern Remote Sales/ SDR Intern Remote Sales Development Representative- Spring Verify Remote Customer Success Associate Remote

title: Sales Development Representative- SpringVerify
jobDescription:
Role Overview
- Love to find new ways to break the ice with someone you've never met?
- Does people psychology excite you?
- Does rejection motivate you to try another way?
- Do you use humor / emotion / stories to cut through transactional conversations and make them more personal?
- do you identify as someone with ‘ High Agency ’? If yes, please reach-out! Does experience matter? Well yes, but if you've got hustle, you'll rack up XP in no time. All we ask is that you are a student of the game / constantly striving to be better than you were the day before. This is for you if are someone who
- aims to be an expert in the domain you are part of; accrue enough knowledge to to the point where are your words are valued by prospects in gold
- can wow people with your ability to write crisp emails that are meant to elicit a response
- needs to lookup and research and individual before reaching out via Linked In / other social platforms with the intent of identifying conversation pieces
- ask more questions to learn and offer specific advice or guidance rather than speak to get points off your chest
- can make use of video tools like Loom to deliver pitches to prospects that cuts through the noise of regular text based emails This is not for you
- if you prefer a 'one-size fits all' type approach to outbound sales
- if you rely exclusively on pricing or a list of 'committed to memory' features as a tool to sell What's most important / non-negotiables
- the ability to stay organized, document in detail and remain persistent
- always be learning
- put every meeting on a calendar
- detail the entire journey from prospect to customer by including crisp notes after every interaction in our CRM
- take clear notes and send meeting minutes within 30m of concluding the meeting What's in it for you (beyond the perks)
- work with an industry leader that is constantly questioning the status quo and disrupting it with tech, first principles thinking and empathy
- learn from some of the best minds in the business across various functions
- Sales, Marketing, HR, Leadership, Product
- supercharge your ability to network and connect with anyone, in any organization by leveraging India's top HR podcast (The Shape of Work) as a host
- access to tight collaboration with the marketing team (Sales Enablement) who will assist you in record turn-around-time with setting up anything you need for success Here is the ICP you will need to sell to:
- India
- Businesses that range from 100-5000 employees in size via an outward sales motion
- Primary buyer of Spring Verify is the HR Ops function; stakeholders can include CEOs / CHROs / VP / Directors of HR Why do they buy Spring Verify?
- Any business with over 50 employees needs to run background checks on their employees. It's even more important when orgs. are trying to secure any data security related certification like ISO27001 / SOC2 / etc.
- Fast scaling businesses need an agile / nimble / highly automated / technology driven solution vs. the more traditional / /slow / manual / operations heavy options available in the BGC industry
- New age companies dedicate significant resources to improve candidate onboarding experience. Spring Verify augments that experience by delivering a rich user experience
- Businesses can significantly reduce their on-boarding time of new joiner by up to 10 days per employee CTC Offered : 25k/month+ Uncapped Commissions Performance-Based Incentives (OTE): In addition to the base stipend, interns have the opportunity to earn incentives based on deals closed. Incentives are calculated per SAO (Sales Accepted Opportunity) based on the customer segment: Small (SMB with 1-200 size): ₹1000 Mid (Mid-market with 201-1000 size): ₹2000 Small Enterprise (with 1001-5000 size): ₹3000 Big Enterprise with 5001+: ₹3500 How it works: Your monthly target is floating based on your stipend. For example, if your stipend is ₹15,000 and you're closing Small (SMB) accounts — you need to hit your base target + 1 additional SAO to start earning incentives of ₹1,000 per SAO. The more you close and the larger the accounts, the higher your take-home. Benefits Health scheme that covers physical, mental, and social well-being. Reimbursement of up to $30 per month for AI tool subscriptions to enhance learning and everyday productivity. 30 annual paid leave days to relax and recharge. Company outings and celebrations to bond and have fun. Freedom and flexibility of asynchronous communication. title: Customer Success Associate
jobDescription: Role Overview: We are in search of proactive and communicative candidates who are passionate about our products and the clients we serve. The Customer Success Associate will act as a point of contact for our clients, responsible for managing and growing the company's relationships with them. By developing long-lasting, mutually beneficial connections, you will strive to find the products that best fit each client's individual needs. Please note: Visits to client offices are a key requirement for this role, so apply only if you’re comfortable with client-facing travel. Local travel expenses within city are not reimbursable. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients. Act as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, addressing issues or concerns and providing timely, effective solutions. Collaborate with sales, marketing, and product teams to develop account strategies that drive revenue growth and customer retention. Understand the client's business and industry to identify opportunities for growth. Ensure the timely resolution of client concerns and issues. Attend industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to build relationships and promote our products and services. In Your First Month Fully understand our products, services, policies, and systems. Familiarize yourself with CRM (Zoho) and other necessary software. Be introduced to key accounts and understand their business needs and goals. Start building relationships with key stakeholders of each client. In Three Months Develop strong client relationships and begin independently managing client issues. Gain an understanding of industry trends and competitor activities. In Six Months Independently manage client accounts and resolve issues effectively. Develop strategies for retention and growth within the current client base. Start mentoring CX Interns on the process flow. Requirements Graduates with interest and knowledge in key customer success/account management duties. Proven knowledge in customer-facing account management in a B2B environment. Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients, understanding their needs and providing tailored solutions. Experience in upselling, cross-selling, and renewals. Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM software like Zoho. CTC Offered: 4-6 LPA Benefits Health scheme that covers physical, mental, and social well-being. 30 annual paid leave days to relax and recharge. Freedom and flexibility of asynchronous communication. Join us at Springworks and contribute to our mission of delivering exceptional value to our clients.
